decision_gate.denominator: Sum of native decision-window exposure ticks from first real sampled action to last live tick. Count lost active lives including terminal death.
decision_gate.ratio: (deaths per native tick with spare potential)/(deaths per native tick with progress alone)
decision_gate.admission: Report six assigned original endpoints per arm. A formal physical-rate decision requires six matched strict pairs in both arms. No additional gradient before review.

registration_note: The original pre-update Stage 2 endpoint is preserved. This additional operational decision rule was released after fitting and before any held input.
